newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes remain steady in moderate session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes remain steady in moderate session.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes remained in familiar price territory Tuesday afternoon, failing to budge much from outright and grade levels seen earlier.

Cash traders said refiners were reluctant to become too active in the markets. Trepidation over the course of events in Canada -- related to troubled throughputs on the Interprovincial Pipe Line -- helped keep grade buyers quiet.

Latest reports from the IPL had oil flows at only 75 percent of normal. A pair of crude lines were restarted earlier Tuesday after being shut by a power outage from late Saturday at a Minnesota pumping station.
